posts.description: Relaxing Match-3 puzzle game to restore nature, forests, rivers and Earth.

posts.name: Koshbook
posts.tagline: AI-powered cashbook for effortless money tracking
posts.description: Koshbook is an AI-powered personal cashbook that makes tracking income and expenses effortless. Log transactions with voice, ask questions about your spending, manage budgets and bills, and keep your financial data private.

posts.name: H9A
posts.tagline: Count any digit in any range — instantly.
posts.description: H9A counts how many times a digit (0–9) appears across any range of numbers. Unlike brute-force scripts, it uses a closed-form O(log n) algorithm, so a range from 1 to 1,000,000,000,000 returns instantly. It prints a colorized, step-by-step breakdown of each decimal place, supports machine-readable JSON, and can render terminal-style screenshots.

posts.name: PicJury
posts.tagline: Create photo polls. Share a link. Decide faster
posts.description: PicJury is a free photo poll maker for decisions that are easier to see than explain. Add 2–6 photos, ask a question, share one link, and let your friends vote in seconds. Use it to choose a profile picture, outfit, logo, thumbnail, product design, room idea, or anything else visual. No account or app required

posts.name: Digmoro
posts.tagline: Research product opportunities before you build.
posts.description: Explore product opportunities from product momentum and recurring customer pain points, with a curated Feed and structured Product and Opportunity Reports.

posts.name: Adyap
posts.tagline: Know what to learn and build, every day, for your dream job
posts.description: Daily career roadmap, AI mock interviews, and personalized learning that gets you hired.

posts.name: CreateMy-QR
posts.tagline: All QR & Barcode Tools in One Place
posts.description: CreateMy-QR is a privacy-first QR & barcode suite built for absolute security: • 100% Client-Side: Processed entirely in your browser with 0 bytes uploaded to any server. • 37+ Specialized Tools: Generate custom QR codes (WiFi, WhatsApp, vCard, PDF) and retail barcodes instantly. • High-Res Export: Download clean vector SVG or PNG files. • Free Forever: No limits, no sign-ups, and no paywalls.

posts.name: Teamlilit
posts.tagline: Timetable, billing, and live classes for tutors in one app
posts.description: Teamlilit puts the whole tutoring business in one place: weekly timetabling, attendance, invoicing, student records, and live online classes. Attendance feeds straight into billing, so the hours you actually taught are the hours you invoice, no rebuilding totals in a spreadsheet every month. The classroom is built in, not a Zoom link, and its whiteboard handles maths equations and graphing properly. Works for solo tutors and multi-tutor centres. EU-hosted, GDPR compliant.

posts.name: GestorMSP
posts.tagline: All-in-one RMM, PSA & ITSM for MSPs — with native AI
posts.description: Most MSPs juggle separate RMM, PSA and helpdesk tools - alerts pile up, tickets stall, and your team burns out. GestorMSP replaces the whole stack with one AI-native platform: monitoring, remote control, patch management, ticketing, billing and CMDB, all multi-tenant and auditable. Built-in AI predicts failures before they hit your clients and executes real fixes on endpoints, VMs and Kubernetes - with MFA and full governance. Stop firefighting; run your entire MSP from one place.

posts.name: Kuaför Adisyon
posts.tagline: Everything your salon needs, in one simple app
posts.description: Kuaför, güzellik merkezi, berber, lazer epilasyon ve SPA salonları için adisyon programı: online randevu, WhatsApp hatırlatma, seans/paket takibi, personel prim ve kasa raporları. 14 gün ücretsiz, kart bilgisi gerekmez.

posts.name: Wortweg
posts.tagline: Solve the Puzzle Game and Grow Your German Vocabulary
posts.description: A German vocabulary trainer in the shape of a word-path puzzle. Weave a path through a grid of letters to uncover hidden German words — and learn what each one means as you solve it. The puzzle is the hook; the learning is the point.

posts.name: Invoicify
posts.tagline: Simple invoicing for freelancers and small businesses
posts.description: A modern developer-first task tracking and auto-invoicing dashboard. Log billable project hours, aggregate unbilled time, and stream server-side vector PDFs directly using Next.js App Router, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, and PDFKit.

posts.name: BodyFastLane
posts.tagline: India's best AI wellness app — workouts, rewards & brain gym
posts.description: BodyFastLane is India's best AI wellness app — AI-powered workouts, step tracking with rewards, guided meditation & brain training, with nutrition personalized for Indian diets. Download free on the App Store.

posts.name: Mosaic
posts.tagline: Turn rough ideas into reviewed plans with Codex
posts.description: Mosaic is a local macOS planning workspace that turns rough product ideas into durable docs and interactive HTML designs with Codex. Review generated candidates, comment in context, inspect diffs, validate changes, and approve immutable revisions—all stored on your Mac. The free first alpha focuses on Plan Studio for Apple Silicon Macs.

posts.name: DocuTalk
posts.tagline: Meet DocuTalk – the app that lets you chat with your docs!
posts.description: Meet DocuTalk – the app that lets you chat with your documents! Scan your documents, ask questions, or extract info across languages in seconds. Turn static documents into dynamic conversations. Try now!

posts.name: OrderRestro
posts.tagline: Open-source POS for modern restaurants
posts.description: Manage your restaurant smoothly with NodeDR OrderRestro's Point of Sale. Handle orders, tables, and kitchen prep on one free, self-hosted platform. Try it now!

posts.name: Kwotix
posts.tagline: Your daily quote puzzle: Pop culture, literature & more.
posts.description: Decipher daily iconic quotes, viral memes, movie lines, and more in a fast, ad-free web game. No login, 100% free.

posts.name: SiteVault
posts.tagline: Auto-lock sensitive websites when you step away
posts.description: Protect your email, banking, work, and personal websites from curious eyes. SiteVault automatically locks selected websites with a PIN whenever you're idle, switch tabs, or navigate away. Local-first, privacy-first, and built for Chromium browsers.
